review.readiness_note: Visual sign-off for the captured 390px direct-request state. A still capture cannot verify Accept, Decline, Save or Inspect outcomes, failure handling, or the subsequent accepted-work state.
review.why: This is a faithful system translation, not a misplaced copy of the Home layout. The 16px gutters, 12px Story handoff, intact supplied sheet, restrained source shadow and separated conditional payment reproduce Frame Shift’s relationships. Longer real titles, conditions and dates wrap without clipping. The request is clearly unaccepted: its business message precedes two explicit decisions, payment remains conditional, and no waiting, secured or accepted-work controls are falsely shown. Eligibility and posting requirements remain accessible below the decision plane. No material visual drift or capture-visible functional loss warrants a change.
review.verdict: Yes—Frame Shift is faithfully adapted to this Story direct request, with the visible functionality preserving the distinction between an invitation and accepted work.
